svg.text: Figure 2. The camera policy of rl/pixel_ppo: two Steel cameras → a frozen VLA or a trained CNN → actor/critic, with a privileged-information curriculum

docs/pixel_ppo.md — node policy_vla (this figure's numbers): continues policy_vla_10hz (stage 2 of the rate curriculum). Node policy_pixel runs the CNN path through the full privileged → unprivileged curriculum (panel b).
g: gate, 1 = this world's episode also reads the privileged state
both cameras rendered, then the actor/critic forward; the policy acts at 50 Hz, the VLA refreshes at 5-10 Hz and is held in between
in: ℝ586 = adapter 512 + proprio 21 + priv 52 + g 1
in: ℝ54 = priv 52 + t/T + g (no cameras)
used in training only — at test time, g = 0 (cameras + joints alone)
The curriculum: privileged → unprivileged, with a DAgger teacher
privileged-information dropout (Kamienny et al. 2020), node policy_pixel; the VLA path (panel a) stays at stage 0 (privileged = 1) and only varies the control rate
PPO, one network, residual on the demo
teacher drives g=1, student (cameras+joints) drives g=0
iter 116: 97.6%-held-out policy_rl replaces the frozen stage-0 copy
teacher labels every state regardless of who drives
evaluated with g = 0: cameras + joints only
DAgger loss (from stage 1 on, every visited state, teacher's and student's, is labelled):
L(θ) = LPPO(student's episodes) + β · Eall states ‖μθ(o | g=0) − sg[ateacher]‖², β = 1

replay: the last 4 iterations' labelled states (8,192 each) kept on the GPU, half of every supervised minibatch — without it the student swung 25% ↔ 4% between iterations (fit only the states just visited)
vla-lab-a100b (4x A100), 2026-11-26 — node policy_vla_10hz, stage 2 of the rate curriculum (policy_vla continues it at 50 Hz)
drives the g = 1 worlds from iteration 116
